prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 92.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 94.7%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 76.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 40.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Reorder: Reorder the onboarding journey so that sign_in occurs immediately after adoption_certificate, letting users customize and adopt their pet before authentication. (why: Allowing users to build emotional investment with pet selection and adoption certificate before sign-in improves overall completion rates.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Visibility Diagnostics Flow: Add an interactive display and window overlay diagnostic checklist flow on the waiting screen while the pet spawns. (why: Support receives complaints about pets not showing up on the desktop or failing to open, while users wait a median of 201s during the home spawn step.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence and Cloud Restore Hint: Add a prominent cloud restore hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that logging in automatically recovers existing pets without losing progress. (why: Support logged 8 emails regarding pets going missing or resetting after signing in again on existing accounts.)
3: [home, wait_info] Spawntime Animated Companion Activity Feed: Display an animated pet preparation progress status component on the waiting screen showing real-time pet assembly stages. (why: The median waiting time is 201s (mean 2336s), leading to user drop-off if spawn progress feels uninspired or static.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Choice Path Showcase Layout: Change the choose_path layout to a split showcase comparing standard instant pets and custom generated pet options side by side. (why: Choose path step takes a mean of 514s and drops 17% of users who are uncertain about which path fits their needs.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Quick Reference Copy: Update the home_intro copy to clearly explain mouse hotkeys and tray icons for showing, hiding, and chatting with the pet. (why: 3 users contacted support confused about how to hide or interact with the pet once onboarding ended.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Arrival Audio-Visual Ready Notification: Enable desktop ready notifications and sound chime prompts on the waiting screen when pet initialization completes. (why: With a median wait of over 3 minutes on the home screen, users tab away to other applications while waiting for spawning.)

scores.note: Deferring sign-in builds emotional investment before auth, but requires flow structural changes.
Addresses support complaints during 201s wait, but building new diagnostic screens is costly.
High evidence from support emails and cheap to implement via simple UI hint.
Engages users during the long 201s wait time on the home screen.
Targeted step drops 17% with 514s mean time; side-by-side layout clarifies choice.
Finish step drops 23.9% and support logged confusion; text copy update is cheap.
Notifications bring back users who tab away during the 3+ minute wait.
